hot_path: public projected visual-token grid + decoder positions
KNOWN_HIGH_CONFIDENCE -> typed perceptual delta when policy permits
UNKNOWN/AMBIGUOUS/CONFLICT/action-critical -> reuse same encoded buffer in Qwen semantic decode
typed PerceptualField -> GWT/effect proposal -> verified outcome/re-entry
feature_ladder: F0 projected mtmd token-grid descriptor (default experiment)
F1 Qwen3.5 pre-merger vision hidden-state descriptor (research-only reference tap; not default runtime)
F2 MobileCLIP2-S0 independent tiny encoder baseline
F3 DINOv3 ViT-S/16 dense-feature adversarial baseline
mechanism.spatial_descriptor_candidate: Normalize public decoder x/y positions; compute global mean+variance and coarse 2x2/3x3 token-grid pooled descriptors; compare rather than assume.

state_lifetimes.L2_RAW_MTMD_EMBEDDINGS: ephemeral same-cycle buffer by default; permitted to feed MVC and semantic decode; not canonical durable truth
state_lifetimes.L3_LLAMA_RUNTIME_MEDIA_STATE: optional rebuildable version-bound performance cache/checkpoint; never semantic authority

identity_binding: LLM continuation/recurrent-state epoch where L3 is used

expected_benefit: avoid duplicate Qwen image encoding during same-cycle escalation
avoid persisting high-volume raw embedding tensors as semantic state
permit exact/lightweight MVC comparison without committing to private model hooks
keep server cache an optimization that can be discarded/rebuilt
architecture_deltas.strongest_counterhypothesis: A tiny independent image encoder is sufficiently cheap and much better calibrated that Qwen feature reuse loses total Pareto value; or the representation/lifetime typing costs more complexity than it saves.
architecture_deltas.rollback: Revert to QNDRF-1/current dissolved perception baseline; disable L3 cache reuse; keep raw Qwen encode->semantic decode and existing MVC baseline independently recoverable.
architecture_deltas.promotion_gate: No promotion until target-runtime matched evidence on user-specific held-out/open-set GUI fixtures and restart/resource tests.
